name: Awesome Launch80 List
description: Community-owned inference repos from the Launch80 Discord, as structured records.
guidance: Hard requirements (hardware.architectures, hardware.gpu_count.min, hardware.min_vram_gb, software.os, conflicts) are binary gates: never recommend a record whose gates the user fails. Rank the rest by maturity and verification.level, not by the largest tok/s number. Cite record IDs and state verification.level. A missing field means unknown, not unsupported.

vendor.intel: Intel Arc / Data Center GPUs (oneAPI / XPU stack).

architecture.rdna2: AMD RDNA2 consumer/workstation GPUs (gfx103x), e.g. Radeon Pro V620.
architecture.rdna3: AMD RDNA3 consumer/workstation GPUs (gfx110x), e.g. RX 7900 XTX.
architecture.rdna3_5: AMD RDNA3.5 APUs (gfx115x), e.g. Strix Halo / Strix Point.
architecture.rdna4: AMD RDNA4 GPUs (gfx120x), e.g. Radeon AI PRO R9700, RX 9070 XT.
architecture.cdna: AMD CDNA1 datacenter GPUs (gfx908), e.g. Instinct MI100.
architecture.cdna2: AMD CDNA2 datacenter GPUs (gfx90a), e.g. Instinct MI210 / MI250X.
architecture.cdna3: AMD CDNA3 datacenter GPUs (gfx942), e.g. Instinct MI300X.
architecture.intel_arc: Intel Arc Alchemist / Battlemage GPUs, e.g. Arc B580.
architecture.nvidia_blackwell: NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, e.g. RTX Pro 6000, DGX Spark (GB10).

runtime.vllm: vLLM or a vLLM fork (including the Radiance image).
runtime.custom_engine: A standalone inference engine that is not a fork of the runtimes above.
runtime.diffusion: An image/video diffusion pipeline rather than an LLM runtime.

quantization.nvfp4: NVIDIA FP4 checkpoint format (may be served via conversion on AMD).
quantization.gguf_q4_0_rocmfp4: GGUF Q4_0 re-packed for the ROCmFP4 llama.cpp path.

feature.tool_calling: Supports tool/function calling through the API.
feature.mtp: Multi-token prediction heads used as a speculative draft.
feature.tensor_parallel: Splits a model across GPUs with tensor parallelism.
feature.pipeline_parallel: Splits a model across GPUs with pipeline parallelism.
feature.p2p: Uses or enables GPU peer-to-peer transfers.
feature.continuous_batching: Serves concurrent requests with continuous batching.
feature.kv_compression: Compresses the KV cache to extend context or save memory.
feature.moe_expert_cache: Keeps only hot MoE experts resident to fit larger MoE models.

os.proxmox: Proxmox VE host with GPU passthrough to a guest.

topology.multi_gpu: Three or more GPUs in one host.
topology.multi_gpu_p2p: Three or more GPUs in one host with peer-to-peer enabled.
topology.multi_node: GPUs spread over more than one host.

kind.runtime_fork: A fork of an existing inference runtime.
kind.patch_set: Patches applied on top of an existing runtime.
kind.kernel_library: GPU kernel library or kernel patches.
kind.docker_image: A prebuilt container image and its build sources.
kind.launcher: Launch scripts / configs for an existing runtime.
kind.deployment_guide: Step-by-step deployment documentation or stack guide.
kind.eval_dataset: An evaluation dataset or harness for model quality.
kind.test_harness: A harness for testing a model or pipeline on specific hardware.

maturity.recommended: Repeatable setup, recently tested by a maintainer or volunteer, clear documentation.
maturity.supported: Active project supported by its author, but environment-sensitive or narrow.
maturity.experimental: Promising proof of concept or work in progress; expect manual debugging.
maturity.historical: Useful reference, but no longer the suggested default.
maturity.unverified: Submitted but not yet reproduced by a maintainer or community volunteer.

verification_level.unverified: Nobody outside the author has confirmed the setup or its numbers.
verification_level.author_reported: The author published the setup and results; not independently reproduced.
verification_level.community_reproduced: At least one community member reproduced it on their own hardware.
verification_level.maintainer_verified: A list maintainer reproduced it and recorded the versions used.

audience.beginner: Follows a guide; expects copy-paste commands.
audience.operator: Comfortable with Docker, drivers and launch flags.
audience.developer: Comfortable building runtimes from source and applying patches.
audience.kernel_hacker: Comfortable debugging GPU kernels, compilers and ROCm internals.

benchmark_mode.single_stream: One request at a time; per-request decode speed.
benchmark_mode.not_reported: The source did not state concurrency — do not compare with the modes above.

source_type.discord: A message in the Launch80 Discord.
source_type.repository: The project's own README or results files.
source_type.list_entry: The description in this list before structured records existed.

paths.i_want_to: Run a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint on one R9700
paths.why: The most-recommended starting point in #r9700; malicz adds a full Docker + MXFP4 setup on the Radiance base.
Highest prefill/decode numbers reported for R9700 in this list.
paths.caveat: Numbers are author-reported and concurrency is not stated; benchmark your own endpoint before comparing.

paths.i_want_to: Use SGLang instead of vLLM on RDNA4
paths.why: The community's starting point for SGLang on RDNA4.

paths.i_want_to: Run quantized models on one RX 7900 XTX
paths.why: The best llama.cpp uplift many 7900 XTX owners saw; hipEngine fits up to 232K context at Q4_K_M.

paths.i_want_to: Serve models on Radeon Pro V620s
paths.why: rocmfp4-llama is the recipe members use on V620; the vLLM path suits multi-card rigs.

paths.i_want_to: Serve a MoE model that does not fit in VRAM
paths.caveat: Target GPU architectures are not yet recorded.

paths.i_want_to: Run fast inference on MI210 / MI100
paths.why: mi210-llm-stack maps models to serving tiers first; int8-vllm is the MI100 path.

paths.i_want_to: Build a multi-GPU box with working P2P
paths.why: Documents passthrough, P2P and the RCCL patches needed to make P2P work; vllm-radiance-p2p is the RDNA3 equivalent.
The community's go-to benchmark suite; use it so your numbers are comparable to others'.
Only Arc datapoint listed; vllm-expert-cache includes Intel porting docs.
paths.caveat: No LLM-serving recipe for Arc is listed yet.

paths.why: R9V is actively maintained in-server for the R9700.

projects.name: davetha/aiter-cdna2
projects.tagline: Binary-patches AMD AITER (officially CDNA3+) to unlock its fast paths on CDNA2.
projects.use_it_if: You have MI210/MI250X-class GPUs and want the AITER kernels that most MI210 performance work depends on.

projects.name: Alloyium-ai/alloyium
projects.tagline: Real-time communication between agents using existing Claude/ChatGPT subscriptions.
projects.use_it_if: You want multiple agents on your existing subscriptions to talk to each other in real time.

projects.name: GGZ14/BetterBench
projects.tagline: The community's go-to benchmark suite for vLLM and llama.cpp endpoints.
projects.use_it_if: You have a running endpoint and want numbers comparable with what others post in the Discord.
projects.notes: Includes a graded code corpus, --runs N, and --quick mode.

projects.name: BMorgan1296/qwen3.6-vllm-gfx1201-launchers
projects.tagline: Fork of the zzpanic launchers with fixes and DFlash changes contributed in-server.
projects.use_it_if: You are using the zzpanic launchers and need the fixes and DFlash changes made in the Discord.

projects.name: Capicua25x/vllm-rocm-rdna4
projects.tagline: RDNA4 vLLM fork — Qwen 3.8 27B MXFP4 at 200K context with MTP on 2× RX 9070 XT.
projects.use_it_if: You have RDNA4 cards (RX 9070 XT or R9700-class) and want long-context MXFP4 serving with MTP.

projects.name: cztomsik/clown-circus
projects.tagline: Minimal agent harness where the model writes its own prompts, with reasoning-trace inspection.
projects.use_it_if: You are experimenting with agent prompting and want to reduce over-thinking.

projects.name: 0xSero/deepseek-v4.1-flash-4x-rtx-pro-6000
projects.tagline: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 4× RTX Pro 6000 at ~200 t/s TG / 7k PP at 8k context.
projects.use_it_if: You have a 4× RTX Pro 6000 (Blackwell) box and want to serve DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

projects.name: bkvargyas/dual-r9700-vllm-proxmox
projects.tagline: 2× R9700 on Proxmox with PCI passthrough and P2P on EPYC, with RCCL patches and benchmarks.
projects.use_it_if: You are building a dual-R9700 server under Proxmox and need working P2P inside the VM.
projects.notes: Includes RCCL patches that fix P2P bugs and full benchmark results (not yet normalized into benchmark records).

projects.name: shisa-ai/hipEngine
projects.tagline: From-scratch RX 7900 XTX inference engine with ~5.7x near-lossless KV compression and MTP.
projects.use_it_if: You have an RX 7900 XTX and want maximum context (up to 232K at Q4_K_M) from a single card.
projects.notes: v0.5.0 adds DMS KV compression (author reports 100% top-1, 0.001 KLD). Shared in #rx7900.

projects.name: curvedinf/int8-aiter
projects.tagline: The INT8 AITER kernels behind the 4× MI100 972 t/s result.
projects.use_it_if: You are building INT8 inference on CDNA and want the kernels without the full vLLM fork.

projects.name: curvedinf/int8-vllm
projects.tagline: INT8-optimized vLLM — Qwen3.8-27B C8 at 972 t/s TG / 5,680 PP on 4× MI100.
projects.use_it_if: You have MI100s (CDNA1) and want high-throughput INT8 serving.

projects.name: davetha/krea2-intel-arc-b580
projects.tagline: Krea2 image-model test harness on Intel Arc B580.
projects.use_it_if: You own an Intel Arc card and want a working datapoint for running a modern model on it.
not_suitable_for: LLM serving — this is an image-model harness

projects.name: StillDeadcode/libr4d
projects.tagline: gfx1201-specialized HIP kernel library (pure HIP, llama.cpp-friendly).
projects.use_it_if: You are developing or tuning kernels for RDNA4 and want a community gfx1201 kernel base.

projects.name: LibreShockwave/LibreShockwave
projects.tagline: A Ruffle-equivalent for Adobe Shockwave, running old Shockwave content in modern browsers.
projects.use_it_if: You want to run legacy Shockwave content in a modern browser.

projects.name: stew675/llama-cpp-rdna-boosts
projects.tagline: llama.cpp performance patches for RDNA3 — the biggest prompt-processing uplift many 7900 XTX owners saw.
projects.use_it_if: You run llama.cpp on an RDNA3 card and want faster prompt processing without switching runtimes.
projects.notes: Also live as the rdna-boosts branch of stew675/llama.cpp. Members report a few hundred t/s of extra prompt processing (no normalized record yet).

projects.name: magiccodingman/vllm-radiance
projects.tagline: Radiance rebased onto current vLLM main with DFlash2 and MXFP4 work merged in.
projects.use_it_if: You have an R9700 and want the Radiance-specific paths on a newer vLLM/PyTorch/ROCm stack, and can debug an experimental build.

software.stack_notes: AMD PyTorch 2.12 / Triton 3.7.1 / AITER 0.1.20 / ROCm 7.14 (as stated by the author).

projects.name: malicz/vllm-gfx1201-launchers

projects.notes: Built on Deadcode's and Brian's work; includes patches such as patch_dflash_w4a16_kv.py.

projects.name: davetha/mi210-llm-stack

projects.tagline: vLLM build with the AITER patches for MI210, including a full INT8 Qwen3.8-27B recipe.

projects.name: tonyd2wild/Minimax-M3-NVFP-3x-DGX-Sparks-TP-3
projects.tagline: MiniMax-M3 NVFP4 across 3× DGX Spark with tensor parallelism 3.
projects.use_it_if: You have several DGX Sparks and want to serve MiniMax-M3 across them.
projects.notes: Builder recorded by GitHub owner; Discord handle not yet recorded.

projects.tagline: Work-in-progress community fork merging RDNA2 vLLM work into one shared gfx1030 repo.

projects.tagline: European-Portuguese legal LLM eval — ~800 lawyer-graded questions over a 21k-article law corpus.

projects.name: Dyluhn/R9V

./scripts/build-rdna2.sh
